description.value: Established in 2008, The Bard and the Banker is a full-service pub on Victoria's historic Government Street, housed in what the business itself calls 'arguably the most beautiful room in Victoria.' The kitchen produces a scratch-made, locally sourced menu, and the bar pours from 31 craft and import taps alongside handcrafted cocktails and an award-winning wine list that has earned the Wine Spectator Award of Excellence six years running. Live music is featured daily across a range of genres, making it a lively destination in the heart of downtown.
